name: empty-content-success
doc: FANG-13: a STRUCTURALLY VALID provider response that carries no content at all is not an error anywhere in the stack - it comes back as HTTP 200 with a sentence the runtime made up itself. This is deliberately NOT the no-choices.json shape: an empty `choices` array is caught at openai.rs:753 and becomes LlmError::Parse, i.e. a failure. Here `choices[0].message.content` is the empty string with finish_reason=stop, which openai.rs:779 (`if !text.is_empty()`) drops on the floor, producing a CompletionResponse with an empty content vec and StopReason::EndTurn. agent_loop.rs:732-756 (the 'Empty response from LLM - guard activated' branch) then SUBSTITUTES a canned sentence for the missing answer and returns Ok. Two turns, one per branch of that guard: turn 1 (steps 0-1) runs a tool first, so the guard picks the `any_tools_executed` string '[Task completed - the agent executed tools but did not produce a text summary.]' - the runtime asserts completion on a turn where the provider said nothing. Turn 2 (steps 2-3) has no tool call, so the one-shot retry at agent_loop.rs:706-729 fires on iteration 0 and the guard's other string is returned on iteration 1. Both turns: HTTP 200, no error field, tokens billed. Run with --tools memory_store.
